mapper.sql: SELECT r.room_id, r.site_id, r.room_environment, r.name, r.description, r.max_traffic_per_second, r.capacity, r.enabled, r.default_rule_type, r.default_destination_url, r.ad_image_url, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.created_ip, r.updated_by, r.updated_at, r.updated_ip FROM room r

where.if: AND ( LOWER(r.room_id) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{query}), '%') OR LOWER(r.name) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{query}), '%') OR LOWER(COALESCE(r.description, '')) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{query}), '%') )

mapper.select: ORDER BY r.enabled DESC, r.room_id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

INSERT INTO room ( room_id, site_id, room_environment, name, description, enabled, max_traffic_per_second, capacity, default_rule_type, default_destination_url, ad_image_url, created_by, created_ip, updated_by, updated_ip ) VALUES ( #{roomId}, #{userSiteId}, #{roomEnvironment}, #{name}, #{description}, #{enabled}, #{maxTrafficPerSecond}, #{capacity}, #{defaultRuleType}, #{defaultDestinationUrl}, #{adImageUrl}, #{createdBy}, #{createdIp}, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedIp} ) RETURNING *
mapper.update: UPDATE room SET enabled = false, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_ip = #{updatedIp} WHERE site_id = #{siteId} AND enabled = true
mapper.select:
SELECT rule.room_id, rule.rule_seq, rule.value, rule.match_operator, rule.description, rule.created_by, rule.created_at, rule.created_ip, rule.updated_by, rule.updated_at, rule.updated_ip FROM room_rule rule JOIN room rm ON rule.room_id = rm.room_id WHERE rule.room_id = #{roomId} AND rm.default_rule_type != 'ALL'
AND rm.site_id = #{userSiteId}

INSERT INTO room_rule ( room_id, rule_seq, site_id, value, match_operator, description, created_by, created_ip, updated_by, updated_ip ) VALUES ( #{roomId}, COALESCE((SELECT max(rule_seq) FROM room_rule WHERE room_id = #{roomId}), 0) + 1, #{userSiteId}, #{value}, #{matchOperator}, #{description}, #{createdBy}, #{createdIp}, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedIp} ) RETURNING *
